summary.caption: A full-color Japanese anime comic page with fine clean lineart, soft cel shading and delicate winter daylight. Four background panels form a descending sequence on the left: a narrow face close-up strip at the top, a hand-and-clasp detail strip, a snowy forest panel, and a taller face close-up at the bottom left. The first three background frames extend behind one large unframed full-body Toki illustration standing on the right. Her continuous fur-lined cloak silhouette overlaps the horizontal gutters and the right edge of the lower-left panel, hiding only the borders behind her body. The large illustration is a foreground cutout, not an additional fifth panel, and has no rectangular border of its own. All background snow, fir trees, skin, hair and clothing are fully colored. Read the four dialogue items from top to bottom. Chinese dialogue uses printed lettering.

items.label: object
items.caption: panel 1, softly blurred snowy fir trees with deep green needles and pale blue winter daylight, a narrow horizontal background strip whose right part lies behind the large foreground cloak.

items.label: character
items.caption: panel 1, close-up of asuma toki (blue archive), long light-blonde hair framing her face, clear blue eyes, her recognizable white maid headband tucked inside the hood and a small pale-blue geometric halo above it, framed by the same a deep navy winter cape with a large ivory-fur-trimmed hood and thick ivory fur along its opening and hem, subtle silver geometric embroidery and small silver chest clasps, worn over an opaque high-collared blue-and-white maid uniform. Only her head and the upper hood are visible. She turns slightly left toward the teacher outside the page, with relaxed eyebrows, attentive open eyes and gently parted lips. Keep her face in the left side of the strip; her hands and full body remain outside this close-up.

items.label: text
items.caption: panel 1, first speech bubble, spoken by asuma toki (blue archive), a rounded white bubble beside the small face close-up in the upper open area, tail toward her visible mouth; horizontal printed Chinese lettering in black, medium legible glyphs, without covering her face.

items.label: object
items.caption: panel 2, close-up of deep navy cloak fabric, cream fur trim and the small silver fastener at the chest, shaded with soft blue reflected light from the snow. This is a detail crop of the same outfit, not a different character or another inset panel.

items.label: object
items.caption: panel 2, close-up showing only one white-gloved hand belonging to asuma toki (blue archive), gently holding the small silver clasp of her navy fur-trimmed cape. Her wrist enters from the lower left; the fingers and thumb remain together around the one clasp, with a narrow strip of her sleeve visible. Cropped at the forearm, without her face or full-body pose.

items.label: text
items.caption: panel 2, next speech bubble, spoken by asuma toki (blue archive) outside this hand close-up, bubble near the upper-left frame edge where her voice comes from above the cropped view; horizontal printed Chinese lettering in black, medium legible glyphs.

items.label: object
items.caption: panel 3, a quiet path between snow-covered dark green fir trees, pale-blue shadows on white snow and a small distant warm golden window light. Keep the left area open around the dialogue; the right part is partly occluded by the large foreground cloak. No additional person stands in this background.

items.label: character
items.caption: panel 3, the single large page-wide foreground cutout of asuma toki (blue archive), long light-blonde hair framing her face, clear blue eyes, her recognizable white maid headband tucked inside the hood and a small pale-blue geometric halo above it, wearing a deep navy winter cape with a large ivory-fur-trimmed hood and thick ivory fur along its opening and hem, subtle silver geometric embroidery and small silver chest clasps, worn over an opaque high-collared blue-and-white maid uniform. The cape hangs to the lower calves and conceals most of the body; only a narrow high-collared maid bodice and white apron are visible through the front opening. Opaque dark leggings and simple navy winter boots complete the outfit. Full-body three-quarter view, standing upright on snowy ground with balanced weight and one boot slightly ahead of the other. Body faces toward the right, while her head turns left toward the teacher. Her expression is composed and quietly attentive, lips closed with a subtle softening at the corners. One gloved hand rests lightly against the fur near her upper chest, and the other arm hangs naturally under the cape. Pale-blonde strands remain visible inside the hood and the small blue halo floats above it. Her ivory-fur hood occupies the upper-right page; the heavy cloak forms one continuous silhouette down through the middle gutters to her boots near the lower-right page. It intentionally crosses in front of the background borders belonging to panels 1, 2 and 3 and overlaps only the right edge of panel 4. The foreground figure has no rectangular frame, stays one coherent body, and does not become a fifth panel. Keep the left-side speech bubbles and the lower-left close-up face readable.

items.label: text
items.caption: panel 3, next speech bubble, spoken by the viewer outside the frame, placed low on the left side of the snowy path near the viewpoint where the teacher stands; horizontal printed Chinese lettering in black, medium legible glyphs. Do not introduce a visible teacher.

items.label: object
items.caption: panel 4, a softly lit ivory-fur hood against a pale-blue winter background, within the tall lower-left frame. The large foreground cape may cover only the far-right border, leaving the close-up eyes and mouth readable.

items.label: character
items.caption: panel 4, face close-up of asuma toki (blue archive), long light-blonde hair framing her face, clear blue eyes, her recognizable white maid headband tucked inside the hood and a small pale-blue geometric halo above it, framed by the same ivory fur hood, with only the upper collar visible below her chin. Her eyebrows stay relaxed, her blue eyes soften as she looks toward the teacher on the left, and the corner of her mouth lifts into a small warm smile as she replies. The smile is a modest change from the earlier attentive expression, not a broad laugh. Keep the main facial features to the left of the large foreground cloak edge.

items.label: text
items.caption: panel 4, final speech bubble, spoken by asuma toki (blue archive), a rounded white bubble at the lower left beside the close-up, tail toward her visible mouth; horizontal printed Chinese lettering in black, large legible glyphs. Keep her eyes and mouth unobscured.
